Here are the newest young cats (ages 1–3 years) available for adoption in the Seattle, WA area on Petfinder, sorted by the newest additions:

---

### 1. Saylor – Loving Siamese Girl
- **Location:** Seattle, WA (Red Waggin Rescue) • 8 miles away
- **Age & Gender:** Young (1–3 years) • Female
- **Breed:** Lynx Point Siamese / Bombay & Domestic Short Hair mix
- **Appearance:** Cream/Ivory and Gray/Blue/Silver with short hair
- **Personality:** Calm, gentle, quiet, and extremely affectionate. Unlike most vocal Siamese, Saylor has an adorable quiet meow where barely a squeak comes out. She loves attention, snuggling, and wet food (she's a bit of a canned-food diva!).
- **Compatibility:** Good with cats and dogs; litter-box trained.
- **Bonus:** Fostered with and bonded to Rip (can be adopted together or separately).
- **Profile:** https://www.petfinder.com/cat/saylor-loving-siamese-girl-4b956a11-8114-4edf-a35d-85df65418e8d/wa/seattle/red-waggin-rescue-wa576/details/

---

### 2. Rip – Playful Baby
- **Location:** Seattle, WA (Red Waggin Rescue) • 8 miles away
- **Age & Gender:** Young (1–3 years) • Male
- **Breed:** Lynx Point Siamese / Bombay & Domestic Short Hair mix
- **Appearance:** Cream/Ivory and Gray/Blue/Silver with short coat
- **Personality:** Playful, full of kitten energy and sass! Loves wrestling, running around, eating, and sleeping. When tired, he'll cuddle right up next to you.
- **Compatibility:** Great with other playful cats and dogs; litter-box trained.
- **Bonus:** Fostered with Saylor.
- **Profile:** https://www.petfinder.com/cat/rip-playful-baby-8661b48d-019f-45de-a7d0-20250d21d69f/wa/seattle/red-waggin-rescue-wa576/details/

---

### 3. Toulouse and Berlioz (Bonded Brothers)
- **Location:** Seattle, WA (Alley Cat Project) • 4 miles away
- **Age & Gender:** Young (~1 year old) • Males (bonded pair)
- **Breed:** Domestic Short Hair (Brown / Chocolate Tabby)
- **Personality & Story:** Named after the kittens in *The Aristocats*, these two brown tabby brothers were rescued as tiny kittens from the Seattle Opera House! While initially shy, they have blossomed into affectionate companions who wake you up as a warm pile of purring cats. Berlioz loves curling behind your desk chair for unpaid moral support while you work, and Toulouse is obsessed with blanket-covered feet.
- **Compatibility:** Good with other cats; house-trained, neutered, and vaccinated.
- **Profile:** https://www.petfinder.com/cat/toulouse-and-berlioz-9c0a44d1-be33-4669-9f90-f751906c24c2/wa/seattle/alley-cat-project-wa500/details/
